note: Dry-run only. Faults the FAKE model provider injects on a given fan turn (1-based count of the persona's 'say' steps). A fault list is consumed in order, one entry per model call that it matches. Never used by --live.

faults.expect: primary http_429, then the fallback answers
provider returns a different model id than requested; both ids are recorded
refusal: no retry, no fallback, handed to a human
unknown outcome keeps its reservation; fallback answers
empty completion: no retry, no fallback, handed to a human
validator rejects the first draft, one corrected regeneration
primary 429, fallback refuses: handed to a human, no further call
passes the validator, violates the operator rubric (R10): rejected by sim-operator-1
